name: ParaSwap Augustus V6 arbitrary-call approval drain

classification.summary: AugustusV6.uniswapV3SwapCallback() did not verify that msg.sender was a genuine Uniswap V3 pool and trusted the caller-supplied data for the payer and token, so anyone could invoke it directly and make the router transferFrom any wallet that had approved it.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

sources.note: onchain review: victim 0x00000000fdac7708d0d360bddc1bc7d097f47439 is the verified AugustusV6 contract created 2024-03-13 by 0x91cee75acbdd7be57bacb40fdeaa4e27dc5154b3 (ParaSwap deployer), not by the extractor 0xfde0d1575ed8e06fbf36256bcdfa1f359281455a; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events between creation and the incident block Recheck of the deployment basis (DELEGATECALL audit): AugustusV6 is a diamond: its fallback DELEGATECALLs a facet looked up in diamond storage, so the executing code can change without an EIP-1967 event. Exactly two DiamondCut(...) logs (topic 0x8faa70878671ccd212d20771b795c50af8fd3ff6cf27f4bde57e5d4de0aeb673) exist between the creation block 19426044 and the incident block 19470561: the first inside the creation tx 0xc2106bf2138a03abfca84ae3cd5465fc64ad29caed5d27b7523059517572a0ef (facet 0x45961104C01199eaa552046290ad3B12513600cB), the second in tx 0xb18ac879242944544f397d3f20d511085b507cf45bdbd5cd2cf52c57076df5f5 at block 19426051, 2024-03-13T12:07:59Z (timestamp 1710331679), 84 seconds later, adding four more facets plus an init contract 0xfc6dd98f962bb487289c8ad4f3a2732972a1ad34 - a ParaSwap deployer action, not the attacker's. Measuring from that last cut gives codeAgeSeconds 1710872735-1710331679 = 541056 instead of 541140, an 84-second correction. The exploited entry point itself did not move: facetAddress(0xfa461e33) for uniswapV3SwapCallback(int256,int256,bytes) returns the zero address at the incident block, i.e. the callback is served by the diamond's own runtime, which is byte-identical at the creation and incident blocks, and facetAddresses() returns the same five facets from the second cut through the incident.

limitations: Classification and loss came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/paraswap.json; legacy measurement.status=OK is provenance only.
The legacy USD loss lacks uniformly structured valuation provenance.
